pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part One, we explored the sudden vanishing of five bombers over the ocean... but when declassified Navy transcripts finally emerged, they revealed something far more disturbing. Flight leader Lieutenant Taylor was heard frantically ordering his squadron to turn east to reach the coast. But other pilots argued back, screaming that if they didn't fly west, they would head further out into the open abyss. Then, the transmission took a truly bizarre turn. Taylor’s voice changed completely, claiming they were entering white water and that they seemed to be flying through outer space. The official Navy report ultimately blamed pilot error, yet quietly noted the cause of loss was unknown. To this day, no wreckage has ever been found. What did they truly encounter out there in the clouds?
